output.reason: [ev-274ce3859ab9] says the `istiod-remote` chart was removed. [ev-5a31c0781dc5] and the upgrade guide [ev-1295567312b0] say it was merged into the `istio-discovery` chart: installs move from `istio/istiod-remote` to `istio/istiod --set profile=remote`, and `istio-base` is now required in remote clusters too. So a release that keeps using the old chart can't move to 1.24 without a mandatory operator step, and migration-required with severity high is right. The proposed statement names a non-existent "istio chart", so I corrected the target to `istio/istiod` (istio-discovery) and added the `istio-base` requirement.

correction.statement: In 1.24 the istiod-remote Helm chart is removed and merged into the istio-discovery (istio/istiod) chart. Remote/external control plane clusters must move to `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote` and also install the istio-base chart.

consequence.statement: The istiod-remote Helm chart is no longer published in 1.24. Remote/external control plane installs that use it must migrate to the istio/istiod (istio-discovery) chart with --set profile=remote, and istio-base must now be installed in remote clusters as well.
consequence.remediation: Replace the istiod-remote release with `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote`, and make sure the istio-base chart is installed in each remote cluster.
